units.text: {el} brings Action for a whole year, reach your chart welcomes. Your effort pays back promptly, as practical plans move at the speed you set.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, and the reach holds. A plan you started last year pays its way, which gives you the footing to widen it with care.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, more chasing than your chart can use. There are more tasks than hours to give them, but you have a short list and the right to say no.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, an effort that works against your chart. You carry last year's list into this one, with the freedom to drop what does not matter.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, a reach your chart runs short of. Each effort you make comes back as something you can hold, an offer, a payment or a plan that moves.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, a reach your chart wants. What you opened last year turns into steady gains, with more of each one staying in your hands.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, strength your chart already runs over with. You meet every exchange as a contest of wills, though time alone and letting a small point go stay open to you.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, strength piled on strength. Each old rivalry you thought had cooled flares up, though a slower pace and help from someone close are yours to call on.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, a strength your chart runs short of. You stand your ground more easily, as equals begin to treat you as one of them.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, a strength your chart wants. Equals take you seriously now, while the place you held back from last year opens to you.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, a voice your chart welcomes. What you make and say lands where you aim it, with pleasure in the making as well as the result.
{el} brings Expression for a second year running, and the outlet stays open. A skill you kept for pleasure begins to pay its way, while new work comes faster than last year's did.

{el} brings Expression for a whole year, more output and appetite than your chart can use. You speak more sharply than you mean, though a pause before each reply and a friend who hears it first are always within reach.

{el} brings Expression for a second year running, a voice that works against your chart. Your outspokenness last year still costs you some goodwill, while finishing what you started gives you solid ground to stand on.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, an outlet your chart runs short of. Words you held back find their way out, while what you make starts to be seen beyond your own circle.
{el} brings Expression for a second year running, an outlet your chart wants. Work you showed last year reaches people who were not there the first time, and your voice gets steadier with use.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, shelter your chart welcomes. Your thinking slows to a useful pace, and shelter is offered before you have to ask for it.
{el} brings Mind for a second year running, and the help holds. Someone you trust stays within reach, while a question you opened last year gets the time it deserves.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, thought that works against your chart. What you have planned stays on paper, though one plain task at a time puts your hands to work.
{el} brings Mind for a second year running, and its comfort works against your chart. Doubts from last year linger, but you have time alone outdoors and someone close who hears them out.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, a support your chart runs short of. Each question you carry finds someone who knows the answer and has the patience to give it.
{el} brings Mind for a second year running, support your chart still runs short of. What you started to understand last year now holds weight, and people come to you to check their thinking.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, structure your chart welcomes. You take on a role with clear edges, the kind where others know what to bring you.
{el} brings Order for a second year running, and the frame holds. Last year's duties settle into habit, but you still give the newer parts of the role your full attention.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, more duty than your chart can use. Your time is claimed from above and from the side, while a quiet hour alone and someone close to talk to stay on your side.
{el} brings Order for a second year running, and the weight does not lift. Demands roll over from last year into this one, but rest you guard on purpose is yours to take.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, a structure your chart runs short of. Your strength takes shape inside a clear role and fair rules, as people learn they can count on your word.
{el} brings Order for a second year running, a frame your chart wants. The role you took on last year settles into its proper size, with your name attached to work done well.
You draw a partner or a household closer this year, and the life you share takes on a firmer shape.
You draw the people after you closer this year, and a younger relative or someone you train comes to count on you.
You bind yourself to a workplace or a team this year, by contract or by loyalty, and its plans start to include you.

You change something at home this year, an address or the way the household runs, and the change asks for your patience while it beds in.
Someone among the people after you changes course sharply this year, a move or a new direction, and staying close costs you effort.
You leave a role or a team you have outgrown this year, by your own choice or by theirs, with everything you learned there going with you.
Something shifts among your older relatives this year, a new address or a change of plans, and old arrangements ask you to bend.
Your home draws people in this year, friends who become regulars or family who come to stay, and the household asks more of your time.
You bring the people after you into one shared effort this year, as their energy and yours pull the same way.

Your older relatives gather around one family plan this year, with you at its centre.
A small resentment grows at home this year without a word said, and the quiet costs you ease in the place you rest.

Something at work sours quietly this year, a colleague or an arrangement, but you are the one left working around it.

You come under closer scrutiny at work this year, with a rule applied to you more strictly than to others and every slip noticed.
You meet closer watching from the older generation this year, with old family expectations that grind on your patience.
Home returns you to an old question this year, a habit or a plan set aside, and going over it costs you an evening or two.
Something you left unfinished with the people after you comes round this year, and going back over it takes time you had set aside.
Work brings you back to an old project this year, a question you thought was done that now wants your hours.
You go back over something from your first home this year, an old habit or an old grievance you thought was settled.

You draw closer to the family you came from this year, with an old tie turning warm and easy to keep.
You tie yourself more closely to the work you choose this year, and the people beside you come to rely on what you give.

{el} brings Mind for a whole year, neither a lift nor a load for your chart. Advice and shelter come at their usual pace, and what you learn sits beside what you know.
{el} brings Mind for a second year running, steady support your chart takes in its stride. Your reading, your rest and the people you ask for advice keep the shape they had last year.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, output your chart can take or leave. You say what you mean at the length you mean it, and your appetites keep their ordinary size.

{el} brings Expression for a second year running, neither pushing nor holding back your chart. Your voice and your appetites stay where last year left them, as the making you do fits the hours you have.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, an even weight on your chart's practical side. You earn and spend at your usual rate, with no big leap to chase and no gap to fill.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, and your practical life keeps level. What you earn, fix and arrange runs as it did last year, without a rush or a shortfall.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, neither a prop nor a burden for your chart. Your duties keep their usual size, and those who count on you ask for what you can give.
{el} brings Order for a second year running, steady weight on your chart. You keep the roles you held last year at the same weight, with no new rank to chase and none to defend.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, your own strength at an even level for your chart. You hold your own with equals at your usual pitch, neither pushing for ground nor giving it up.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, and your strength stays level. Your stamina and your nerve keep last year's measure, with nothing to prove and nothing to hold back.
